steps.js: const b=[...document.querySelectorAll("button[class*='selector-']")].filter(b=>!/In Store|Pickup|Delivery/i.test(b.innerText))[0]; if(!b) throw new Error('no store btn'); b.click(); return b.innerText

const inp=[...document.querySelectorAll('input')].filter(i=>i.offsetWidth&&/zip|city|postal|address|location|search/i.test((i.placeholder||'')+(i.name||'')+(i.id||'')+(i.getAttribute('aria-label')||''))).pop()||[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] input, [aria-modal=true] input')].pop(); if(!inp) throw new Error('no zip input'); inp.focus(); inp.value=''; document.execCommand('insertText',false,'{{store_zip}}'); inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(x=>setTimeout(x,800)); inp.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',code:'Enter',keyCode:13,bubbles:true})); return 'typed into '+(inp.placeholder||inp.id||inp.name)
